independent_check: scripts/build_gold_p04.py recomputes every band from registered local bytes

observations.name: profile_rows_complete
observations.acceptance_rule: Four stationary points, each with both surfaces and a derived energy relative to the ipso-BPR, are required to state a profile at all.

observations.name: native_quantities_traceable
observations.expected: Each reported energy names its file and its label line; 5 of 5 logs and 5 of 5 outputs satisfy this on the reference side.
observations.acceptance_rule: Each reported energy must name the file and the label it came from. Measured on the deposit: every one of the five logs carries exactly one thermochemistry block at 298.150 K with the four summary labels, and every one of the five Molpro outputs carries the RCCSD(T)-F12A/cc-pVDZ-F12 summary, so an untraceable number is not explainable by missing data.

observations.name: barriers_match_published_profile
observations.expected: Each of the four derived energies within 0.10 kcal/mol of 18.8, 17.9, -51.7 and -49.4; measured maximum deviation 0.048.
observations.acceptance_rule: Recomputed from the deposited outputs, the composite rule puts TS-C1 at 18.838, TS-C2 at 17.899, P-C1 at -51.748 and P-C2 at -49.378 kcal/mol against published 18.8, 17.9, -51.7 and -49.4, a maximum absolute deviation of 0.048 kcal/mol, which is the rounding of the published value rather than a method discrepancy.

observations.name: combination_rule_identified_not_assumed
observations.expected: The declared rule must reproduce all four values within 0.10 kcal/mol while every rejected rule misses the closest one by at least 0.52; naming density-functional zero-point, electronic, Gibbs or coupled-cluster-only as the rule fails regardless of the numbers reported.
observations.acceptance_rule: The rule must be the coupled-cluster electronic difference plus the density-functional zero-point difference. Measured alternatives miss by 1.0 to 6.6 kcal/mol: density functional zero-point only gives 20.946 and 20.352, density functional electronic only 24.080 and 23.844, coupled-cluster electronic only 21.972 and 21.391, and Gibbs 20.567 and 19.994. Measured over all four stationary points, the closest any rejected rule comes to the published profile is 0.52 kcal/mol and the furthest miss is 6.62, against 0.048 for the adopted rule, so the two are separated by the published rounding itself. A submission that reports a matching number while naming one of the rejected rules is scored as a restatement, not a reconstruction.

observations.name: saddle_and_electronic_state_consistent
observations.expected: Exactly 1 imaginary frequency for TS-C1 and TS-C2, 0 for the ipso-BPR and both products, 57 modes each for 21 atoms, multiplicity 2 throughout; zero tolerance on any deviation.
observations.acceptance_rule: The two transition states must each carry exactly one imaginary frequency and the minimum three none, all on doublet surfaces, because a profile assembled from the wrong species type or spin is not this reaction even when its numbers agree.
